canDoYue: 你識收款、畀收據同證書，仲識包裝。
canDoEn: Take a card or cash payment, hand over the receipt and certificate, and offer to wrap the gift.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Here's your total. Let me read it out so you can check.
dialogue.glossYue: 總數喺度。我讀出嚟畀你對一對。
dialogue.say: Here's your total. Let me read it out so you can check.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will pay by card, because I do not have enough cash.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會用卡付，因為現金唔夠。
dialogue.say: I will pay by card, because I do not have enough cash.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The payment is approved. Here is your receipt and the certificate.
dialogue.glossYue: 付款過咗。呢度係你嘅收據同證書。
dialogue.say: The payment is approved. Here is your receipt and the certificate.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thank you. Could I also get an invoice for my company?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。可唔可以另外開張發票，等我報公司數？
dialogue.say: Thank you. Could I also get an invoice for my company?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I can wrap the gift and add a card if you want one.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以包裝禮盒，如果你想要，我加張卡。
dialogue.say: I can [[ɹˈæp]] the gift and add a card if you want one.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could I pay with notes if the till machine is busy now?
dialogue.glossYue: 收銀機而家忙嘅話，我可唔可以用紙幣畀錢？
dialogue.say: Could I pay with notes if the till machine is busy now?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以將呢份禮品包裝好？

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Would you like to settle by phone, or would coins be easier today?
dialogue.glossYue: 你想用電話結數，定係硬幣方便啲？
dialogue.say: Would you like to settle by phone, or would coins be easier today?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I pay by phone? I don't have coins.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可唔可以用電話付款？我冇銀仔。
dialogue.say: Can I pay by phone? I don't have coins.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Please keep the receipt with the certificate, in case you need a repair.
dialogue.glossYue: 請將收據同證書放埋一齊，之後要維修都用得着。
dialogue.say: Please keep the [[ɹɪsˈit]] with the certificate, in case you need a repair.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Could you sign here, please? The card needs your signature.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔該喺度簽名。用卡要你簽名。
dialogue.say: Could you sign here, please? The card needs your signature.

understand.prompt: Would you like to pay by card? 即係問緊咩？
understand.explain: pay by card 係用卡付款。現金先至係 cash。

understand.prompt: The payment is approved. Here is your receipt and the certificate. 呢句即係點？
choices: 付款過咗，畀收據同證書
understand.explain: approved 係批咗、過咗。certificate 係證書。

understand.prompt: Here is your receipt. 你遞畀客人？
understand.explain: receipt 重音喺第二節。發票先至係 invoice。

chunks.pattern: Would you like to pay by ___, or is cash easier for you today?
chunks.example: Would you like to pay by card, or is cash easier for you today?

chunks.pattern: The payment is ___. Here is your receipt and the certificate.
chunks.example: The payment is approved. Here is your receipt and the certificate.
chunks.glossYue: 付款⋯⋯。呢度係你嘅收據同證書。

chunks.pattern: Here is your ___, and please keep it with you until you leave today.
chunks.example: Here is your receipt, and please keep it with you until you leave today.

chunks.pattern: Could you ___ the gift so I can carry it home today?
chunks.example: Could you wrap the gift so I can carry it home today?
chunks.glossYue: 可唔可以⋯⋯份禮物，等我今日帶得返屋企？

build.promptYue: Tom 想用現金。你點問卡？
choices: Would you like to pay by card?

roleplay.intro: Tom 喺櫃檯準備付款。等佢講完先答。

turns.expect: Would you like to pay by card?

turns.line: I will pay by card, because I do not have enough cash.
turns.expect: The payment is approved. Here is your receipt and the certificate.

quiz.prompt: 店員講「The payment is approved. Here is your receipt and the certificate.」，certificate 係咩意思？
客人講「I can wrap the gift and add a card if you want one.」，係咩意思？

sound.title: 拍卡入面嗰個音
sound.note: contactless 有 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面，氣由兩邊出。cash 尾係 /ʃ/，唔好讀成 /s/。receipt 重音喺第二節。wrap 開頭唔出聲。
